faq.q: What is a beauty product video template?
faq.a: A ready beauty scene with an AI actor, a voiceover, and a script. Add your bottle, jar, or tube and get a routine, texture, or review clip without filming a creator.

faq.q: How does the routine clip come together?
faq.a: The scene brings a hook, a script, visuals, and a voiceover. Upload your photo, adjust the line, pick 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, and download.

faq.q: Why start here instead of booking a creator?
faq.a: You can post sooner, try another script, and change the line without a shoot. A video is 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30.
Skincare sellers, beauty teams, agencies, and founders. Any person on screen is an AI performer, not a customer who reviewed the product.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo and follow the three steps. Captions, a track from the music library, and the AI voice can be adjusted in the built-in editor.

faq.q: Can the routine skip the face?
faq.a: Yes. Choose hands, a close-up, or a product-only beat when the package should stay the focus.

faq.q: Can I upload my own photos and clips?
faq.a: Yes. Use a JPG, PNG, or WebP of the full bottle, jar, or tube, or a short clip you have rights to. Keep the cap and label easy to see.

faq.q: Where can I publish the clip?
faq.a: Pick 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Publish the file to TikTok or Meta, or to YouTube, in one step from the same project.
24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. You see that number first. A failed job returns those credits. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark and can run in ads, pages, and posts. Match the shade and usage line to the approved listing.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link or a batch?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page link and AIVideosUGC drafts the script, or send several products through the API when a catalog needs the same routine in another language.
